summary: River flooding entered the ground floor of the insured's warehouse. Stock on lower racking damaged; building drying under way.
investigator_notes: Site visit completed. Moisture readings recorded. Awaiting contractor estimate for drying and racking replacement.
next_steps: Obtain contractor estimate; confirm stock valuation with the policyholder.

summary: Small electrical fire in the staff kitchen. Limited smoke damage.
investigator_notes: Cause confirmed as a faulty appliance. Repairs completed.

summary: Delivery van stolen from the insured's yard overnight. Police report filed.
investigator_notes: Vehicle not yet recovered. CCTV requested from neighbouring premises.
next_steps: Wait 28 days for recovery before agreeing a total-loss settlement.

summary: Overnight fire at a retail unit. Significant stock and fit-out loss reported.
investigator_notes: Referred to the fraud team: inconsistencies between the stock records and the reported loss.
next_steps: Fraud team review in progress. Do not discuss with third parties.

summary: Burst pipe in the first-floor office ceiling. Water damage to two rooms and IT equipment.
investigator_notes: Plumber's report received. IT equipment inventory requested.
next_steps: Review the IT inventory and agree the replacement basis.

summary: Third-party injury claim from a visitor at the insured's yard.
investigator_notes: Referred to the fraud team: the same claimant appears in two unrelated claims.
